description: Mutates the dict returned by get_defaults(), which another file shows is the shared module-level object, silently changing defaults for every caller.

change_request.title: More retries for bulk jobs
change_request.description: Bulk jobs need more retries than the default.

from app.defaults import get_defaults


def settings_for_bulk_job() -> dict[str, float]:
    settings = get_defaults()
    settings["retries"] = 10
    return settings
